title: Messages
noThreadText: Choose a conversation on the left to read it here.

list.title: Conversations
list.label: Conversations
list.unread: {count, plural, one {# unread message} other {# unread messages}}

search.label: Search conversations
search.hint: A name or text from a message, then Enter.

empty.alleMember: On a profile, «Write a message» starts a conversation. It then appears here.
empty.alleStudio: Members write to you through your profile. Their messages then appear here.
empty.ungelesenText: New messages you have not opened yet appear here.
empty.favoritenText: Mark a conversation with the star and it appears here.
empty.archiviertText: Archived conversations appear here. A new message brings them back.

labels.manageDescription: Labels are private. Only you see them, members do not.
labels.full: You have reached the maximum of {max} labels. Delete one to create a new one.
labels.deleteText: The label disappears from all conversations. The conversations themselves stay. This cannot be undone.

errors.invalid: Enter a name with at most 30 characters.
errors.duplicate: A label with this name already exists.
errors.limit: You have reached the maximum number of labels.
errors.not-found: This label no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.generic: That did not work. Try again.

live.offline: No connection. Unsent messages stay and can be sent again.

failure.undeliverable: The message could not be delivered.
failure.attachments: An image is no longer available. Upload it again.
failure.rate-limited: Too many messages in a short time. Wait a minute and send again.
failure.invalid: The message could not be sent. Check its length and content.
failure.network: No connection to the server. Your message is not lost.
failure.restricted: Your account is restricted from messaging. The message was not sent.

thread.olderFailed: Older messages could not be loaded.
thread.emptyText: Write the first message to {name} below.

delete.title: Delete message?
delete.description: Text and images disappear for you and for {name}. In their place it says «Message deleted». This cannot be undone.
delete.failed: The message could not be deleted. Try again.

report.descriptionMessage: Moderation receives a copy of this message. The other side does not learn who reported it.
report.descriptionCounterpart: Moderation receives a copy of the other side’s last ten messages. They do not learn who reported them.
report.urgentTitle: In immediate danger, call the police now: 117.
report.urgentText: Moderation handles this report first, but it does not replace an emergency call.
report.sentText: Moderation will review it. You can also block the contact.
report.errorTitle: The report could not be sent.
report.errorText: Your entries are kept. Try again.

composer.blockedText: {name} cannot write to you and is not told. You cannot write either.
composer.tooLong: The message is too long. At most {max} characters.
composer.imagesBusy: Wait until all images are ready.
composer.imagesFailed: First remove the images that could not be loaded.
composer.label: Message to {name}
composer.hint: Enter sends, Shift and Enter adds a line.

failure.rate-limited: Too many images in a short time.

context.title: Details
context.blockedHint: Neither side can write to the other while you block.

context.labelsFailed: The labels could not be saved.

actions.failed: That did not work. Try again.
